notes: Only assigned unfinished fields inspected for completion; all other values are unassigned placeholders. Canonical title and authors match Van Lange et al. (1997). No PDF supplied. Assigned study_o is 1, while description says sample 2 and locator p.6 corresponds to printed p.738 (Study 2).
